what: Screen-height cards stick to the top one after another, and the next card rises from below to cover it. The rising card’s frame scales from .9 at 10% to 1 at 50% of its entry progress (frame top edge at screen bottom → frame bottom edge at screen top) and settles in place. The value is not tied directly to scroll but chases it, covering 20% of the remaining distance each frame (site-builder smoothing 80)

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Sticky card (child) — screen height, position: sticky; top: 0
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Panel that grows inside the card
options.start: Progress at which growing starts, default .1
options.end: Progress at which it reaches full size, default .5
options.smooth: Follow (0~1, share of the remaining distance covered per frame is 1−smooth), default .8 — 0 means instant

from.where: index.html .rv-cases (Work video cards — original case-study-video-item sticky 100vh · background-video IX2 SCROLLING_IN_VIEW 10%→50% scale .9→1, smoothing 80)
